title: Authenticator push notification isn't reaching my phone for MFA
description: When logging in today, I can't receive the codes as a notification on my device; I have to enter a manual code.

worklogs.description: The phone's push service was blocked; the Authenticator app was reinstalled.
The MFA device was re-registered and the push notification came through.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: MFA was set up again, and I saw the 'Approve' notification come through on the phone. Please test again.

resolutionNote: The Authenticator app was reinstalled and the MFA device re-registered. Push notifications returned to normal.
